items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Library accepts fixture, rejects planted defects; LF/CRLF hash equal; consent change changes hash; report schema pinned; dry mode runs without model calls. New files only.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable or non-object brief.json yields defects or (False, reason), NFC collisions raise PathCollision; live mode refused loudly.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Symlinks rejected by validator and never copied to the scratch project; brief_dir traversal and absolute paths rejected; trust anchor of the in-package hash documented.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Independent hand-computed digest, pinned fixture hash, tamper and defect cases, no-subprocess and no-socket dry mode; no skips.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Single pass over a small directory; no unbounded reads.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: lib module under 300 lines; harness is a flat helper beside its tests per integration-tests convention.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer of brief.json hash: round-trip probed (build fixture, verify_hash, CRLF variant, tampered copy).
